newsitem.title: MEXICO: Smith Barney starts Cemex with buy.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney starts Cemex with buy.

text.p: Smith Barney has initiated coverage of Mexican cement maker Cemex SA with a buy recommendation, the company told Reuters on Friday.
Analyst Carmen Slade said in a report that Smith Barney had a price target for Cemex of $11.40, which represented an upside potential of 43 percent.

"Various investor concerns have kept Cemex's FV/EBITDA multiple excessively depressed during the last year. In our view, several actions by management should be addressing these concerns, allowing the multiple to expand forward," Slade wrote.
